title: Newly uploaded videos intermittently fail playback
description: Users report that newly uploaded videos intermittently fail to play, returning HTTP 503 errors. Videos uploaded prior to the incident continue to play normally. The incident began shortly after a deployment to transcoding-service.

canonical_ground_truth.initiating_event: Deployment of transcoding-service v5.4.0 at 17:58 UTC reduced temp workspace size from 50Gi to 10Gi and retained retry files longer
canonical_ground_truth.root_cause_mechanism: Temporary workspace disk exhaustion (ENOSPC) caused FFmpeg temporary file creation failures, leading to transcoding job drops and missing video manifests
downstream_symptoms: transcoding queue depth backlog growing to 970 jobs

evidence.content: upload-service telemetry (17:55 - 18:20 UTC): availability: 99.98%, p95 latency: 390ms, error rate: 0.02%. Active upload channels: 225/300. Upload service is healthy and operating normally.
transcoding-service node disk utilization: node-1: 96%, node-2: 97%, node-3: 98%. Normal baseline: 55%-65%. Critical threshold: 90%. Utilization increase began shortly after 18:02 UTC.

Deployment Event: transcoding-service version 5.4.0 deployed at 17:58 UTC. Previous temporary workspace allocation: 50 GiB. New temporary workspace allocation: 10 GiB. Deployment configuration also changed FFmpeg retry-file cleanup behavior so retry files are retained longer than before.
